label: Начать
description: A 10-sentence conjugation card for начать (to begin, to start).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first person. Начать is perfective, so its non-past is future. 'Начну' is the 1sg, built on the irregular present stem начн-, very different from the infinitive, with the -у ending.
Strategic focus: Perfective future, second person. 'Начнёшь' is the 2sg perfective future of начать on the начн- stem with the stressed -ёшь. 'Работу' is the accusative direct object.

missions.phrase: Он скоро начнёт учить китайский язык.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, third person. 'Начнёт' is the 3sg perfective future of начать on the начн- stem with -ёт. It governs the infinitive 'учить', as начать often takes a following verb.

missions.phrase: Мы начнём собрание через десять минут.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Perfective future, first-person plural. 'Начнём' is the 1pl perfective future on the начн- stem with the stressed -ём. 'Собрание' is the neuter accusative object.

Strategic focus: Perfective future, third-person plural. 'Начнут' is the 3pl perfective future of начать on the начн- stem with -ут, closing the non-past set. It governs the reflexive infinitive 'учиться'.

missions.phrase: Вчера я начал читать новую книгу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine past tense. 'Начал' is the past m. sg. of начать, with stress on the first syllable. The perfective marks the start as a single completed event, governing the infinitive 'читать'.

missions.phrase: Она начала готовить ужин в шесть.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Feminine past tense. 'Начала' is the past f. sg. of начать, where the stress shifts onto the final -а, a notable irregular pattern. It governs the infinitive 'готовить'.
Strategic focus: Plural past tense. 'Начали' is the past pl. of начать, with stress back on the first syllable. The perfective marks the beginning of the repair as a completed point in time.

missions.phrase: Начни наконец делать зарядку по утрам.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Singular imperative. 'Начни' is the informal command of начать, formed from the future stem начн- plus -и. The perfective imperative urges one decisive start, governing the infinitive 'делать'.
Strategic focus: Infinitive use. 'Начать' is the bare perfective infinitive after 'хочу', expressing intent to start. Its imperfective partner начинать is used for ongoing or repeated beginnings.
